## Activity

During February 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 493 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the planned session lists, apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that capture sessions continued without any reported disruption requiring operational follow-up. The clinic’s output provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Graders identified 8 captures as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.6. This result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for the month. The image-quality outcome was recorded for routine monitoring and provides a measure of the proportion of submitted captures that could not be assessed.

## Grading

A total of 147 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval recorded for grading during the reporting month. Together, the referable result count and grading-lag measure support ongoing oversight of the service’s assessment activity. These figures should be reviewed through the usual site monitoring arrangements, with attention to maintaining timely grading and consistent capture quality.
